newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading light after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading light after hours.

text.p: Trading activity was light after hours Friday, trader said.
The New York Stock Exchange said Alpharma Inc and Raychem Corp were unavailable for after hours trade for news.
The NYSE said session one volume was 59,500 shares, compared to 337,000 shares Thursday.
The NYSE said there was no volume in session two Friday. Thursday's session two volume was 840,600 shares.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
